note: One 16-bar cycle = 256 steps; step 256 repeats step 0 (loop point). Only mode="game" is traced in full here: mode="menu" (calm) is a pure function of the game-mode trace — see calmTransform below — so it is not duplicated step-by-step.

calmTransform.drums: suppressed entirely, EXCEPT during a breakdown bar (part.breakdown && barInSec<2) where game mode plays nothing anyway, so calm has no breakdown tick either (tick is itself gated on !calm)
calmTransform.bass: vol becomes 0.3 (vs 0.55 in game mode); note/timing unchanged
calmTransform.arp: unchanged (arp does not depend on calm/mode at all)
calmTransform.hypeSparkle: never plays in calm mode regardless of the hype flag (gated on `!calm`)
calmTransform.melody: vol *= 0.6 (vs *1 in game mode); note/timing/harmony unchanged
